researchEvidence.note: Ohio EPA describes the asbestos program as licensing and certifying companies and persons directly involved with the asbestos abatement industry.
Ohio EPA directs asbestos licensing and certification workflows to the Asbestos Services database.

Ohio EPA eBusiness Center lists asbestos certification, licensing, training applications, and asbestos abatement notifications as available services and requires OH|ID/eBiz account access for account data.

blocker.summary: The official asbestos licensing service is tied to Ohio EPA eBusiness account workflows, and OpenTrade Registry will not bypass login or technical controls.
